entries.title: Event: Morgantown 2024 election roundtable discussion
entries.summary: Join reporters from Mountain State Spotlight for a discussion around the issues that matter to you this election season.
entries.content:
Election season is underway, and that means candidates will be out vying for your vote.

We want you to help guide Mountain State Spotlight’s election coverage.

What do you want the candidates to be discussing as they compete for your vote? We want to hear from you!

Building on our reader-informed election agenda, we want to hear about the issues you face each day that you think candidates can — and should — address on the campaign trail

Join reporters and editors from Mountain State Spotlight and other community members for a guided roundtable discussion about what issues are most important for you this election season.

Event details

What: Guided community roundtable discussion around election issues

When: Wednesday, April 24 5:30-7:30

Where: Wiles Hill Community Center Gymnasium

About Mountain State Spotlight: Mountain State Spotlight is an independent, reader-supported newsroom covering West Virginia.

Funding for this event provided by the Jonathan Logan Family Foundation.
